segments.caption: A serene beach scene unfolds under a clear blue sky, where gentle waves rhythmically roll onto the sandy shore. The calm, turquoise ocean stretches to the horizon, bordered on the right by the dark silhouette of a distant hillside. The consistent, soothing motion of the water creates a tranquil and peaceful atmosphere.

A serene beach scene unfolds under a clear blue sky, with gentle waves rolling onto the shore. The camera remains stationary, capturing the tranquil rhythm of the ocean. As the scene progresses, a pod of dolphins suddenly appears in the distance, swimming gracefully through the turquoise water, adding a dynamic and lively focal point to the otherwise peaceful coastal landscape.

A pod of dolphins gracefully swims and plays in the shallow, turquoise waters near a sandy beach under a clear blue sky, with gentle waves lapping the shore and a green hillside visible in the distance.

A pod of dolphins playfully swims and breaches in the shallow, foamy waters at the edge of a sandy beach, drawing the attention of onlookers who stand nearby, while a green, hilly coastline stretches under a bright blue sky.

A group of dolphins is seen stranded on a sandy beach, with people rushing to their aid. Several individuals, including those in orange shirts, are actively working in the shallow water to push and guide the dolphins back into the sea, while others watch from the shore. The scene unfolds on a sunny day with a clear blue sky and a hilly coastline in the background, capturing a moment of coordinated human effort to rescue the marine animals.

On a sunny beach with a green hill in the background, a group of people are urgently helping a pod of stranded dolphins back into the ocean. Several individuals wade into the shallow water, pushing and guiding the dolphins as waves wash over them, while others stand on the shore watching the rescue effort unfold.

On a sunny beach with a green hill in the background, a group of people are actively helping a pod of dolphins that have washed ashore. Several individuals wade into the shallow water, gently pushing and guiding the stranded dolphins back toward the deeper ocean, while others stand by on the sand, observing the rescue effort.
